The attentional processes are not stable over time, but fluctuate according to biological and environmental rhythms.

The attention system is a multi-component system that includes both alerting and orienting networks, and that is modulated by arousal, motivation, and task demands.

the development of attention is a complex process, involving the interaction of many variables.
